name: VANTAGE: Autonomous Defence Intelligence
summary: A multi-agent AI framework for cybersecurity, with agents for vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and incident investigation. Our team builds the project's chatbot, a retrieval-augmented assistant with chat and voice that lets security teams work with the system in natural language.
summary_sl: Večagentni sistem UI za kibernetsko varnost z agenti za oceno ranljivosti, penetracijsko testiranje in preiskovanje incidentov. Naša ekipa razvija klepetalnik projekta – pomočnika, ki odgovarja na podlagi virov (RAG), za klepet in glas, prek katerega varnostne ekipe s sistemom delajo v naravnem jeziku.

name: PERISCOPE: Participatory Engagement & Resilience Initiative against Strategic Communication and Propaganda in Europe
summary: Countering disinformation, gendered hate speech and foreign information manipulation. We organise capacity-building events that raise media and AI literacy and introduce the tools we have developed for detecting fake news and related threats.
summary_sl: Boj proti dezinformacijam, sovražnemu govoru na podlagi spola in tujemu informacijskemu manipuliranju. Organiziramo dogodke za krepitev zmogljivosti, ki dvigujejo medijsko in UI-pismenost ter predstavljajo orodja, ki smo jih razvili za odkrivanje lažnih novic in sorodnih groženj.

name: ViroiDoc: Advanced Research on Viroid Pathogenesis and Control for Agricultural Sustainability
summary: A doctoral network training ten researchers on viroids, the smallest infectious plant pathogens. We train the doctoral candidates in data visualization and in using AI in research.
summary_sl: Doktorska mreža, ki usposablja deset raziskovalcev na področju viroidov, najmanjših kužnih rastlinskih patogenov. Doktorske kandidate usposabljamo za vizualizacijo podatkov in uporabo UI v raziskavah.

name: EnviroViroSeq: Advanced HTS and AI-powered Analysis of Viromes in Hops and the Environment
name_sl: EnviroViroSeq: napredna analiza viromov v hmelju in okolju z visokozmogljivim sekvenciranjem in UI
summary: Mapping viromes in hops, weeds, wild hops and irrigation water to find pathogen reservoirs and see how irrigation spreads them. The project combines Nanopore high-throughput sequencing and CRISPR-based detection with AI-supported analysis. It is led by the Slovenian Institute of Hop Research and Brewing, with the Biotechnical Faculty (UL). At JSI we develop the AI and data-visualization pipelines that help detect viroids.
summary_sl: Kartiranje viromov v hmelju, plevelih, divjem hmelju in vodi za namakanje, da bi odkrili rezervoarje patogenov in ugotovili, kako jih širi namakanje. Projekt združuje visokozmogljivo sekvenciranje Nanopore in detekcijo na osnovi CRISPR z analizo s pomočjo UI. Vodi ga Inštitut za hmeljarstvo in pivovarstvo Slovenije, sodeluje Biotehniška fakulteta UL. Na IJS razvijamo analitične postopke UI in vizualizacije podatkov, ki pomagajo pri zaznavanju viroidov.

name: TWON: Twin of Online Social Networks
summary: Digital twins of online social networks: LLM-driven agents simulate debates and information spread on social media, so platform designs can be tested before they reach real users. We built the software platform for large-scale simulations, and a second platform for running the project's use-case studies.
summary_sl: Digitalni dvojčki spletnih družbenih omrežij: agenti, ki jih poganjajo veliki jezikovni modeli, simulirajo razprave in širjenje informacij na družbenih omrežjih, tako da je zasnove platform mogoče preizkusiti, preden dosežejo prave uporabnike. Razvili smo programsko platformo za obsežne simulacije in še eno platformo za izvajanje študij primerov uporabe v projektu.

name: AI4Gov: Trusted AI for Transparent Public Governance
summary: Trustworthy, explainable and unbiased AI for public administration. We created a catalogue of bias-detection methods, tools for detecting bias in data and AI models, and open online courses (MOOCs) on trustworthy and democratic AI in English, Slovene and Spanish.
summary_sl: Zaupanja vredna, razložljiva in nepristranska UI za javno upravo. Pripravili smo katalog metod za zaznavanje pristranskosti, orodja za zaznavanje pristranskosti v podatkih in modelih UI ter odprte spletne tečaje (MOOC) o zaupanja vredni in demokratični UI v angleščini, slovenščini in španščini.

name: NAIADES: Water ecosystem digitization
summary: AI for the urban water sector. We developed anomaly detection for water networks, predictions of water consumption and demand, and an observatory of water data built from open data to support evidence-based decisions.
summary_sl: UI za urbani vodni sektor. Razvili smo zaznavanje anomalij v vodovodnih omrežjih, napovedi porabe vode in povpraševanja po njej ter observatorij vodnih podatkov, zgrajen iz odprtih podatkov, ki podpira odločanje na podlagi dokazov.

name: Fusion pore regulation in insulin secretion
name_sl: Uravnavanje fuzijske pore pri izločanju inzulina
summary: Live-cell TIRF imaging of single insulin granules in pancreatic β-cells, showing how cAMP/Epac2 and PI(4,5)P2 regulate the exocytotic fusion pore and cargo release.
summary_sl: Slikanje posameznih mešičkov inzulina v živih celicah beta trebušne slinavke z mikroskopijo TIRF, ki je pokazalo, kako cAMP/Epac2 in PI(4,5)P2 uravnavata eksocitotsko fuzijsko poro in sproščanje vsebine.

name: Exocytosis in astrocytes
summary: High-resolution membrane-capacitance measurements and STED microscopy of gliotransmitter vesicles, resolving single fusion events and fusion-pore states in astrocytes.
summary_sl: Meritve membranske kapacitivnosti z visoko ločljivostjo in mikroskopija STED mešičkov z gliotransmiterji, s katerimi sem razločila posamezne dogodke zlivanja in stanja fuzijske pore v astrocitih.
